title: Build WorkflowCreatePage with form to create/edit workflows
description:
WorkflowsPage has a "Create Workflow" button linking to `/workflows/new` but no page exists.

**Implementation:**
- Create `dashboard/src/pages/WorkflowCreatePage.tsx`
- Form fields: name (required), trigger type (select: manual/schedule/webhook/event), timeout (input), metadata (key-value pairs)
- Steps section: add/remove steps with type selection, name, depends_on (multi-select of other steps)
- Use `useCreateWorkflow()` mutation to POST to `/api/v1/workflows`
- On success: navigate to the new workflow detail page
- Validation: name required, at least 1 step
- Cancel button returns to /workflows

**Files:** `dashboard/src/pages/WorkflowCreatePage.tsx` (new), `dashboard/src/hooks/useWorkflows.ts` (add mutation), `dashboard/src/App.tsx` (add route)
definitionOfDone: Create workflow form renders with all fields
Steps can be added/removed with dependency selection
Form submits to backend and navigates on success
